resources.string: Rooms the indexer keeps: their history is saved and they can notify you even when K is closed.
How a Room You Create Works
Anyone who types the same name joins the same room. It has no owner and no invite.
No indexer keeps its history. K reads it from the Kaspa network while the room is open, and keeps up to 3 days on your phone.
No notifications while K is closed. With its bell on, K notifies you only while it\'s open.
Everything said there is public: anyone can read it on the Kaspa network.
Add rooms the indexer keeps, like #kaspa, or create your own. Nothing is added unless you choose it.
#%1$s removed. Add it again anytime from Add Room.
Rooms the indexer keeps can be added again from Add Room. Rooms you made are deleted with their messages on this device.

A room the indexer keeps. You added it, and anyone on K can post to it.
